blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-31 across the tracked wrapper surfaces. Reservoir's verified Savingcoin source for Ethereum wsrUSD is a constructor-deployed ERC-4626/ERC20 with MANAGER and DEFAULT_ADMIN roles for cap/rate/update/recovery operations, but no blacklist, freeze, pause, seize, or arbitrary-holder-burn function; the 15 EVM representation deployments use the same 12,275-byte LayerZero OFT code family with ordinary transfer paths. Solana finalized slot 436244454 (2026-07-30T23:20:08Z) for mint 7bxM8cRF... reports freezeAuthority = null. The wrapper therefore has no current local holder-freeze reach. Upstream access is inherited from tracked rUSD: Tempo rUSD TIP-20 currently reads paused() = false and transferPolicyId() = 1 at block 32494649, but the Reservoir admin can activate TIP-403 blacklist/transfer policy, pause, or burnBlocked controls under the TIP-20 standard. Failure domain is the Reservoir rUSD parent/Tempo admin, not wsrUSD's wrapper or OFT contracts.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wsrUSD has one native Ethereum ERC-4626 wrapper and 16 reviewed LayerZero/Solana bridge representations. The Ethereum MyOFTAdapter locks the canonical wrapper while LayerZero OFTs burn and mint on remote routes; the shared Reservoir owner can configure peers, delegates, and LayerZero OApp settings. Berachain source/destination peer asymmetry and unresolved endpoint validator configuration keep this bridge review at manual-review confidence, and the adapter lockbox balance must not be added to destination supplies.

controls.label: wsrUSD Ethereum MyOFTAdapter bridge rail

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: At Ethereum block 25771270, verified MyOFTAdapter 0xbb431abd156b960e5b77cc45c75f107e3991258a returned token() = wsrUSD 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094, endpoint() = LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, and owner() = 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602. It held 29,145,751.33607 wsrUSD; OFTAdapter locks the underlying on source debit and unlocks it on return credit, so this balance is already included in Ethereum totalSupply and must not be added to destination representation supply.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At the same block, selected adapter peers were EID 30184 = Base OFT 0x62344be8...6900b1, EID 30110 = the shared OFT 0x480901...6d75d, EID 30102 = the shared OFT 0x480901...6d75d, EID 30106 = the shared OFT 0x480901...6d75d, and EID 30332 = the shared OFT 0x480901...6d75d. Destination peers(30101) pointed back to the adapter, except the source-side Berachain EID 30181 read zero while Berachain pointed back; this route state remains manual-review.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The adapter had 10,831 bytes of verified non-proxy runtime and zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots. Owner EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602 can configure the LayerZero peer/delegate and OApp settings, but no adapter implementation replacement was evidenced. Enforced options, message inspector/pre-crime, and endpoint DVN/executor/validator configuration were not independently re-read in this review; no favorable validator assumption is made.

controls.capDescription: The adapter is the canonical lockbox and authenticated LayerZero burn/mint transfer rail. Its return path is supply-conserving only while source-side lock accounting and authenticated peers remain intact; it is not independent native Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771270 on 2026-08-16, MyOFTAdapter 0xbb431abd156b960e5b77cc45c75f107e3991258a was a verified 10,831-byte non-proxy adapter bound to wsrUSD 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094, with LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and owner EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602. Its 29,145,751.33607 wsrUSD balance is canonical lockbox inventory already inside Ethereum totalSupply. LayerZero OFT/OFTAdapter source confirms destination burn/mint and source lock/unlock semantics; the adapter, remote OFTs, and their separate contract failure domains remain Bridge Risk rather than native issuance.
